residual_findings.title: AC5 plan wording vs implementation: handlers extracted to `host_tool_handlers.rs` (P1) not `capability/builtins/` as the plan stated
residual_findings.source: qc1-006 + qc2-005 (V1.57 P0 tri-review; PM consolidated at qc-consolidated)
residual_findings.note: Low; PM noted that the plan stub said handlers live in `capability/builtins/`, but the P0 implementation found `capability/builtins/registry.rs` was already the SSOT (V1.53 P0) and P1 extracted the per-ID handlers to `host_tool_handlers.rs` instead. The 18 host tools register via the existing `CapabilityRow { id, access, admission, handler, ACP wire, failure_mode, handler_test_vector }` shape — semantically equivalent to what the plan wanted, just located differently. AC5 was met by intent. Reconciliation: update plan stub in V1.58+ to reflect reality (handlers live in `host_tool_handlers.rs`, not `capability/builtins/`).
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.58 P0 T19 closed: V1.57 plan text AC5 wording reconciled to "18 shipped / 18 catalog-only / 3 scaffold-equivalent / 2 OUT" per the actual 41-row roster (was "35 shipped" claim).

residual_findings.title: Per-ID dispatch test vectors incomplete: many `nexus.*` IDs lack failure-path test (only success-path or smoke test exists)
residual_findings.source: qc1-004 + qc2-004 (V1.57 P0 tri-review; PM consolidated at qc-consolidated)
residual_findings.note: Medium; P0 AC7 promised ≥1 success + ≥1 failure test per ID dispatched through `CapabilityRegistry::dispatch()`. P0 delivered the success-path test (catalog↔registry invariant) and the success-path per-ID smoke, but the per-ID failure-path (admission denied / invalid input) coverage is incomplete. Add in V1.58+ as a test-coverage hardening round.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.58 P0 T20 + P2 T14 closed: per-ID failure-path test vectors added for capability handlers dispatched through CapabilityRegistry::dispatch(). Coverage spans registry.refresh handlers touched in P0 + DF-56 dependent path handlers in P2.
